fields.name: schedule_location_count
fields.normalization: Nonblank data rows after the header.

evidence: Every extracted value carries a verbatim excerpt that code finds on the stated page. Values derived in code carry an observation instead. Absence lists the sources inspected and never invents a quote.
conflicts: When sources state different normalized values, all are kept with their evidence, the value is null, and no source is preferred. A reviewer resolves it with a correction.
csv: Header location_id,address,city,state,zip,construction. Count nonblank data rows after the header.
corrections: A reviewer's correction becomes the value the rules use, marked as a human override. The original value, state and evidence stay visible.
